title: Synthetics — Group overview by Remote cluster (Heartbeat split out of Local)
_setupNote: Runs in the DEFAULT space — the only place all three sources coexist in a single view, because the real remote (CCS) monitor carries meta.space_id=default and a single-space view filters remote pings by that field (the CCS setting's space list does NOT override this; verified). Heartbeat: space-less autodiscovery pings (visible in every space). Remote: needs a real remote (edge-oblt) setup + the CCS `useAllRemoteClusters` setting on; the 'Remote cluster' group-by option only appears when non-heartbeat remote monitors exist. Local bucket is filled by whatever real local monitors already exist in the default space. Trade-off vs the qa scenario: this shot is NOT isolated from your real monitors.
